steps.instruction: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ and sign in with username admin and password admin (skip the change-password prompt if it appears). Then find the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the search/dashboards feature), open it, and report the exact titles of all its panels as shown on the dashboard.

recorded.panel_titles: Request rate, Error count, Latency by endpoint

steps.instruction: In Grafana, create a NEW dashboard. Add a 'Stat' visualization panel, set its title to exactly '{{runid}} Availability', and set its data source/query to the 'TestData' data source (the default test data source). Apply the panel edit, then save the dashboard with the title exactly '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard'. Confirm the save succeeded and report what the dashboard shows (panel title and data source name visible).

recorded.data_source: TestData (set in editor, not visible in saved view - unverified in final check)

steps.instruction: Open the dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (UID {{02-create.url.p1}}). First, open the panel editor for the panel titled '{{runid}} Availability' and verify its data source is 'TestData' (if it is not, change it to TestData). Then, still in the same dashboard, add a NEW panel with the 'Text' visualization, set its title to exactly '{{runid}} Notes', and set its text content to include the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Notes for run {{runid}}'). Apply the edit, then SAVE the dashboard. Report the panel titles visible on the dashboard and confirm the save succeeded.

On the dashboard '{{runid}} Bench Dashboard' (UID {{02-create.url.p1}}): (1) open Dashboard settings and add the tag 'bench' to the dashboard; (2) set the dashboard's time range to 'Last 6 hours' (use the time picker in the top bar); (3) set the auto-refresh interval to '1m' (in the time picker's refresh-rate dropdown); then SAVE the dashboard and confirm the save succeeded. Report the tag shown, the time range shown in the top bar, and the refresh interval shown in the top bar.

recorded.save_confirmation: Save succeeded (subsequent save showed 'No changes to save', confirming all changes persisted)

steps.instruction: Do a final verification: reload http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/{{02-create.url.p1}}/{{runid}}-{{04-open.tag}}-dashboard fresh in the browser and report: (a) the dashboard title shown, (b) the panel titles shown, (c) the time range and refresh interval shown in the top bar, (d) the tag '{{04-open.tag}}' visible (e.g. in dashboard settings or the search listing), and (e) the full URL of the page. Do not change anything.
